أبا جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر

notes: «سمعت أبا جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر يقول» names the Imam in the words after the chain, so he is the last link as imam_in_text, surface as written; the date «في صفر سنة...» is left out; the saying is Musa's (in the Imam's report) and is not a link
